coreProposition: Long-running agent systems should separate the user-delivery plane from the model reasoning-context plane while correlating both through stable message identity and replayable metadata; local acceptance or emission is not evidence of external delivery.

openingMove.purpose: Show how a user can see a progress message that should not automatically become synthetic assistant context for the next model turn.

argumentNodes.question: Why are user delivery and model context different facts?
argumentNodes.claim: User delivery records communication toward a person; model context records information intentionally admitted into subsequent reasoning.
argumentNodes.readerProgress: The reader stops treating one append-only transcript as the only valid history model.

argumentNodes.question: What does the demonstrated mechanism actually guarantee?
argumentNodes.claim: It establishes gated local acceptance, typed asynchronous item emission and context exclusion while preserving delivery classification in protocol and history structures.
argumentNodes.readerProgress: The reader can distinguish local runtime evidence from external transport evidence.

argumentNodes.question: How should the planes remain correlated?
argumentNodes.claim: Stable message identity and replayable metadata should connect delivery events, transport receipts and any later explicit memory admission without copying visible text into model context by default.
argumentNodes.readerProgress: The reader gains a durable multi-plane design rather than simply deleting messages from history.

argumentNodes.question: Where are the reliability boundaries?
argumentNodes.claim: Local accepted=true and item emission do not establish external delivery, acknowledgement, retry, cancellation, exactly-once behavior or global ordering.
argumentNodes.readerProgress: The reader avoids promoting local API success into end-to-end delivery certainty.

counterpoint.claim: A single transcript is operationally simpler and guarantees that the model can see every user-facing update.
counterpoint.responseBoundary: When later reasoning truly needs a delivered fact, an explicit workflow-state or memory admission can add it with provenance; implicit echo is not the only option.

endingStrategy.purpose: End with delivery-receipt ownership, retry identity and explicit memory admission questions.
